description: Create a contact person in weclapp. Required: party_id (the customer it belongs to) and last_name. Optional: first_name, email, phone, fields (any further weclapp field). There is no job-title field on a weclapp contact — put it in fields.description if you need it recorded. WRITES into the customer's ERP — it goes through the permission gate and the weclapp write log.

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

name: create_weclapp_contact
